what_happened: Scene: layout 3, grey/black CoffeeMachine041 (dispenser above a grate tray, round dial and small buttons on the right side of the front), round blue mug_7 on an open wooden shelf above. Stage 0: grasp 131/142 by the rim, mug carried down to the tray (~300), released 357 at 0.0033 m (0.0048 m 2 s later), upright - the most precise placement of the task. Stage 1: the gripper moved to the right of the machine and came at the buttons from the side (420-470), the button registered at 478; stage 0 complete 441 (broke 474-497 while at the button), success 501. official_criterion_notes: Stage 0 broke at 474 only because the gripper came back within 25 cm of the mug at the button.
